name: Jaz
summary: UK-based Instagram meme/creator (handle @yelikejaz, ~20k followers, login barcy26@protonmail.com) who came in for shadow-ban removal and strike/content-restriction cleanup after a previous provider botched appeals on his account. Paid roughly $1k in USDT (ERC20) on 2026-08-02 after ALTR removed the 'limits to reach' shadowban and restored un-appealed removed content; already-appealed items were permanent warnings, which caused some back-and-forth confusion. As of 2026-08-03 he reported a new post removal (Aug 2, flagged for sexual activity) plus reach limits returning, work is in progress with a rep, and he asked to discuss going on a monthly retainer via phone call. He offered to refer friends who run Instagram accounts.
